description: The fold is syntactic, so the shapes it cannot read floor: a stored partial chain names no handlers here, and a dynamic method name names no link.

diagnostics.message: Awaiting `partial` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the promise is named by no call in the syntax, and a parameter, a property, a non-call initializer or a stored partial chain is unknowable from here. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.

Awaiting `rejects()[method](keep)` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the call that produced it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay or override colors it, so it is assumed to reject. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
